acceptanceCriteria: Tick rate is read from sysconf(_sc_clk_tck) or the assumption is documented, with a focused test.
body:
Source: wave-6 lane report (2026-10-11).

Observed: procfs CPU-tick parsing for dispatch idle hard-codes USER_HZ = 100.

Expected: read the tick rate via sysconf(_SC_CLK_TCK) or document the assumption in the spec.

Acceptance: tick rate is read from sysconf(_SC_CLK_TCK) or the assumption is documented, with a focused test.
title: Linux dispatch-idle procfs CPU-tick parsing assumes USER_HZ=100 (CAL-V0-218, V1-1195)
